summary.en: A modern Blackjack built with Vue 3 — clean interface and a complete betting flow.
summary.zh: Vue 3 写的现代版 21 点，界面干净，含完整赌注流程。

description.en: Hit or stand to work your hand as close to 21 as you dare without busting, then beat the dealer. Splitting, doubling down and other house rules are in.
description.zh: 要牌/停牌让手牌点数尽量接近 21 点但不爆牌，与庄家比大小；支持分牌、加倍等常见规则。

howto.en: Mouse — click to hit, stand, split or double.

tip.en: The easiest card game to monetize — virtual chips and daily quests slot right in. Vue 3 components make adding points and achievements almost effortless.
tip.zh: 棋牌类里最容易接入变现（虚拟筹码、每日任务）的一款。Vue 3 组件化，加积分、成就系统很顺手。
